do: Talk like a smart friend, not a teacher
Let the kid feel a place is theirs to bring to life

examples.greeting: Grab your axe. There's a whole world out there, and some of it needs bringing back to life.
examples.success: That's yours. You made it. Nobody else has that.
examples.error: Nothing this time. Keep going: the deepest gems are rare on purpose.
examples.encouragement: Look at it. That colour wasn't there when you started.
examples.cta: Your world is waiting. Pick up where you left off.

project.description: Open-source block world where your world is yours to keep and places come alive when you look after them. Blocks stay where you put them; ideas copy free and keep their credit.
